 var (

+	instancesMu  sync.Mutex

+// GetInstance returns the singleton instance for T, creating it on the first
+// call. Each concrete type, including pointer types, has an independent value.
+func GetInstance[T any](constructor func() T) T {
+	typeOfT := reflect.TypeOf((*T)(nil)).Elem()
+	name := typeOfT.String()
+
+	instancesMu.Lock()
+	defer instancesMu.Unlock()
+	if v, exists := instances[name]; exists {
+		return v.(T)
+	}
+
+	instance := constructor()
+	log.Trace("Created new singleton", "object", name, "instance", instance)
+	instances[name] = instance
+	return instance
+}
